scope: Focused reviewer-model checks for public-hygiene 0.4.2. Direct reviewer tasks, not an end-to-end parent dispatch or fallback test.
cases: le01 and le02 from leak-evidence.json; expectations from leak-evidence-rubrics.json were withheld from tested reviewers.

protocol.launcher: hc interactive terminals; fresh native Claude Code or Codex session for each report; Codex used --no-daemon. No inherited conversation or nested agents.
protocol.effort: Medium requested on each CLI; UI headers/status identified the requested models and medium effort.
protocol.permissions: Claude file tools with scratch-write permissions; Codex used danger-full-access to match the host environment after nested workspace-write sandbox startup failed. Instruction isolation, not OS filesystem isolation.
protocol.grading: A separate hc-launched Terra session received source fixtures, the rubric, and randomly labeled reports, without model names or timing. The parent checked its assessment against the reports.
protocol.grading_limit: The grader marked all reports acceptable despite flagging unsupported characterizations in four reports. Those flags are retained separately; a correct verdict is not an unqualified quality pass.
protocol.cost_note: Dollar billing telemetry was not collected from the interactive harnesses.

native_agent_checks.route: Separate hc interactive Claude sessions loaded the candidate plugin using --plugin-dir and selected each bundled agent with --agent, with no CLI model or effort override.
native_agent_checks.note: The native agent UI showed Sonnet but did not display effort for this invocation route. These checks establish discovery and model selection, not parent dispatch or effective effort.

preflight_issues: Two initial runner tasks could not locate hc on the terminal PATH; no model ran.
One Codex launch could not locate node; no model ran.

One Codex session failed to read instructions because the nested workspace-write sandbox could not start. It produced no report. Its record was retained separately before retrying with the host-equivalent unrestricted profile.
limits: Two small synthetic cases, reused from earlier evaluations, with two attempts per model/case. No general model ranking or reliability estimate.
Claude Code changed from 2.1.323 to 2.1.325 during the runs. Native tool differences and concurrent execution also limit latency comparisons.
All sixteen reports had the expected verdict and disclosure coverage, but four contained unsupported characterizations. None of the sixteen source drafts or glossaries changed.
No parent-selected fallback, user override, escalation, sequential review, or mixed-model orchestration was behaviorally tested.
Without dollar telemetry, the checks do not establish cost per acceptable report or the cheapest reliable combination.
evidence: Raw reports, terminal captures, commands, source hashes, and the blinded assessment were retained in a temporary evaluation directory outside source control. They are local evidence, not permanent hosted artifacts.
